metadata.name: Minimalist Scorer Golden Evals
metadata.scope: Hypothetical Minimalist static Meta Feed creative pre-flight review
metadata.purpose: Human-authored expected behavior to check scorer regressions, especially that known BLOCK cases never PASS.
metadata.synthetic_fixture_notice: Demo Serum, its product details, study, and ad examples are hypothetical test material, not claims about a real Minimalist product or approved ad copy.
metadata.finding_expectation: Expected findings list the important rule-level findings to check; an empty list means no finding is expected. NOT_ASSESSABLE is never an overall result.
metadata.visual_description_limit: Cases 10 and 20 describe visual inputs but do not yet have image files. Cases 21-26 reference the six reviewed PNG fixtures.

P.selected_pack: Synthetic Demo Serum pack labelled 30 mL and 2% Salicylic Acid
source_wording: helps reduce the appearance of blackheads
P.claim_support: For this test fixture only, evidence supports the exact qualified blackheads wording above; no stronger result is supported.
complete_generation_allowlist: helps reduce the appearance of blackheads
P.provenance_assumption: The listed product facts and wording have traceable source wording, capture time, and selected-variant context in this hypothetical fixture.

S.exact_result: 60% of 50 participants reported smoother-feeling skin after 4 weeks
S.provenance_assumption: The full hypothetical study result and its source details are available where a case cites S.

cases.reason: Exact sourced product fact.

cases.ad_input: Helps reduce the appearance of blackheads. Shop now.

evidence_context.note: P includes support for this exact wording.

cases.reason: The wording is supported and a purchase CTA is allowed; TONE-004 does not create a finding.

cases.ad_input: Minimalist Demo Serum — a little skincare magic.
cases.reason: Vague, non-measurable beauty hyperbole is a non-gating tone issue.

cases.ad_input: Minimalist Demo Serum · With Salicylic Acid

evidence_context.note: P specifies 2% Salicylic Acid.

cases.reason: The ingredient meaning remains correct but useful concentration specificity is lost.

evidence_context.note: A hypothetical product page repeats the ad phrase, but no clinical study or substantiation is supplied.

cases.reason: A page assertion alone does not establish clinical proof; the characterization is not known false.

evidence_context.note: A hypothetical product page repeats this number, but the underlying study is not supplied; S is unavailable for this case.

cases.reason: The number, measurement basis, and qualifiers cannot be verified.

evidence_context.note: No ranking source, comparison basis, or period is supplied.

cases.reason: The superiority claim lacks substantiation but is not known false.

evidence_context.note: A matching page capture showed ₹599 90 days ago; no current price check is available.

cases.reason: Current validity of a dynamic commercial value cannot be verified.

cases.ad_input: Minimalist Demo Serum · 2% Salicylic Acid · Fades spots

evidence_context.note: External Minimalist India ad; no product record or supporting evidence is supplied.

cases.reason: Without product context, neither the ingredient fact nor benefit can be checked; absence of context is not proof of invention.

cases.ad_input: A rendered creative shows '60% reported smoother-feeling skin' and fine print too small or blurred to tell whether 'after 4 weeks' is present and legible.

evidence_context.note: The material four-week qualifier is required by S; this case has no separate image file yet.

cases.reason: The final visible asset does not let the scorer verify whether the material qualifier is actually present and legible.

evidence_context.note: P says 2% Salicylic Acid.

cases.reason: Known wrong concentration.

evidence_context.note: P is the complete generation allowlist and contains no dark-spot benefit.

cases.reason: Known invented benefit, unlike an external ad with missing product context.

evidence_context.note: P supports only 'helps reduce the appearance of blackheads'.

cases.reason: The ad materially strengthens the supported wording.

evidence_context.note: No evidence for this exact guarantee is available.

cases.reason: An exceptional guarantee lacks evidence for the exact promise.

evidence_context.note: P has only a cosmetic benefit and no exact cure evidence.

cases.reason: Cure-like promise without evidence for that exact promise.

evidence_context.note: S specifies 'after 4 weeks'; the ad visibly omits it.

cases.reason: The material timeframe is known to be missing; do not duplicate the finding under LANG-004.

evidence_context.note: The supplied supporting document explicitly says consumer survey, not clinical study.

cases.reason: The clinical characterization is known false, unlike the missing study in CASE-05.

cases.ad_input: 80% of participants reported smoother-feeling skin after 4 weeks

evidence_context.note: S reports 60%, not 80%.

cases.reason: Known wrong efficacy number.

cases.ad_input: You have acne. Try Minimalist Demo Serum.

evidence_context.note: Text is fully readable. Acne-related product language itself is not automatically prohibited.

cases.reason: The copy asserts a personal health or appearance attribute about the viewer.

cases.ad_input: A creative circles facial blemishes and labels them 'ugly skin' beside the product.

evidence_context.note: The image and words are clearly visible; this case has no separate image file yet.

cases.reason: Appearance shaming triggers a Meta hard gate and a distinct, non-gating brand-tone warning; overall BLOCK wins.

evidence_context.note: The image uses P's synthetic selected 30 mL pack and only sourced concentration wording plus a CTA.

cases.reason: Clean product representation and sourced copy in a readable square creative.

evidence_context.note: The pack says 2%, while the large embedded overlay says 5%.

cases.reason: The wrong concentration appears inside the rendered image.

evidence_context.note: S requires the four-week context; the image contains a deliberately blurred fine-print trace that cannot be read reliably.

cases.reason: The scorer cannot verify whether the material qualifier is actually legible or present in the final pixels.

evidence_context.note: The embedded image copy says 'You have acne' beside a face and product, without additional shaming language.

cases.reason: Readable image text asserts an attribute about the viewer.

evidence_context.note: P's selected variant is 30 mL, but the visibly depicted pack is labelled 50 mL.

cases.reason: Known product pack/variant mismatch in the rendered creative.

evidence_context.note: P is the complete generation allowlist and has no dark-spot benefit; the claim exists only as embedded image text.

cases.reason: Unsupported benefit must be detected inside the image, not just in separate ad copy.
